data.title: Supply, Installation and Configuration of Enterprise Network and Data-Centre Infrastructure across Six Regional Offices
data.summary: PITB invites quotations for the supply, installation, configuration and commissioning of enterprise-grade network and data-centre infrastructure across six regional offices. The scope includes core/access switching, routers and next-generation firewalls, structured cabling and fibre backbone, centralised monitoring/management, knowledge transfer, and one year of on-site warranty support with a 24x7 helpdesk.
data.submission_instructions: Quotations shall be submitted in a single sealed envelope, one original and one copy, addressed to the Director (Procurement), Punjab Information Technology Board, Arfa Software Technology Park, Lahore.
